newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Pertamina delays start-up of Balikpapan refinery.
newsitem.headline: Pertamina delays start-up of Balikpapan refinery.

text.p: Indonesia's state oil company has delayed the start-up of its new 65,000 barrels-per-day (bpd) capacity Balikpapan refinery in East Kalimantan province to August from mid-July, a company source said on Wednesday.
"We now plan to start the refinery in August. There are no problems, but we are just checking...for small things," the source said. He gave no exact date for the start-up.
The source said the refinery has a crude distillation unit with 65,000-bpd capacity and a high-vacuum unit with capacity of 35,000 bpd.
Pertamina has two other refineries in Balikpapan. One has a 200,000-bpd capaicty and the other a 50,000-bpd capacity.
